name: Money
description: Converts between 30+ currencies at today's rates from the European Central Bank (via Frankfurter, open data).
author: Hob

tools.name: convert_currency
tools.description: Convert an amount of money between currencies at the latest official rate. Use ISO codes like EUR, USD, JPY, GBP.

from.description: Currency code to convert from, e.g. EUR

to.description: Currency code to convert to, e.g. JPY

tools.title: Converted {amount} {from} to {to}

starters.title: How much is 50 euros in Japanese yen?
starters.prompt: How much is 50 euros in Japanese yen?

prompt: For converting money between currencies, use convert_currency (live rates) instead of searching.
